brand.store_description: Shop Kaza Beauty for premium skincare and makeup products, including serums, creams, lip gloss, lipstick and kajal, designed for radiant, healthy-looking skin.
brand.brand_story: KAZA Beauty was created with one simple belief: beauty should enhance confidence, not hide individuality. We combine high-performance formulations, trend-driven innovation, and skin-loving ingredients to create products that deliver effortless, everyday luxury. From flawless essentials to statement-making makeup, every KAZA Beauty product is designed to empower you to look beautiful, feel confident, and express yourself—because true beauty begins with confidence.

products.name: Kaza Beauty Clear Code Serum
products.taxes: Taxes included; shipping calculated at checkout
products.description_site:
Kaza Beauty Clear Code Serum is a lightweight, fast-absorbing niacinamide serum designed to help refine the look of pores, control excess oil and improve uneven-looking skin. Powered by 10% niacinamide, it supports a smoother, clearer and more balanced complexion without leaving the skin sticky or heavy.

With regular use, the serum helps reduce dullness, improve skin texture and maintain a fresh, shine-controlled finish. Its gentle everyday formula layers easily under moisturiser, sunscreen and makeup.

Key benefits:Minimises the appearance of pores • Controls excess oil • Brightens dull-looking skin • Smooths uneven texture • Lightweight and non-greasy

How to use: Apply 2–3 drops to clean, dry skin before moisturiser. Use once or twice daily, followed by sunscreen during the day.
